# Dr. Luqman "Lucky" Javed, DVM | AI Systems Architect, SEO Strategist & Veterinarian

> Dr. Luqman Javed (known professionally as Lucky) is an AI Systems Architect, Technical and Local SEO Lead, Creative Strategist, and Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) based in Porto, Portugal. He applies clinical diagnostic methodology and variable isolation to multi application AI ecosystems, search architecture, and paid acquisition.

## Core Pillars & Capabilities

* [Overview & Unified Philosophy](https://luqmanjaved.com/): How clinical diagnostics, human psychology, technical search, and AI systems converge into one cohesive methodology.
* [AI Systems & Workflow Orchestration](https://luqmanjaved.com/ai-systems): Model routing across Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini; 13 app enterprise agency ecosystems with Dual Payload JSON state handshakes and pre compaction circuit breakers; workflow automation in n8n, Zapier, and Quickwork.
* [Technical SEO, Local SEO & GEO](https://luqmanjaved.com/seo-geo): Deep Screaming Frog diagnostics, centralized Global Power Block JSON LD schema graphs, Core 30 Google Business Profile architectures, and 40 to 60 word Atomic Answers for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Assistive Agent Optimization (AAO).
* [Scientific Creative Strategy](https://luqmanjaved.com/creative-strategy): Voice of Customer review mining, awareness stage script routing, and single variable isolation (including a $500,000 North American collagen launch scaled to a 6.0x ROAS). Exclusive one client at a time roster.
* [Veterinary Medicine, Animal Nutrition & Authorship](https://luqmanjaved.com/vet-authorship): Doctor of Veterinary Medicine with postgraduate training and certifications in feline, canine, integrative (CIVT), and exotic animal nutrition. Former Operations and QA Lead at Pangolia, published across Catster, Dogster, Hepper, PangoVet, The Vet Desk, and Discover Magazine, and former official veterinarian host on the Catster YouTube channel.
* [Thought Leadership Essays](https://luqmanjaved.com/blog): Full length essays on AI model routing, the Unsell Yourself prompt protocol, creative strategy as a counterweight to AI drift, and multidisciplinary careers.
* [Direct Contact](https://luqmanjaved.com/contact): Reach Lucky directly at admin@luqmanjaved.com.
